title: Cooktown Museum
scope: Standing former St Mary’s Convent and School, now Cooktown Museum. Covers the historic L-shaped gothic brick ranges, west two-storey veranda, roof dormers and rear gallery and kitchen volume.
limitations: Current side and rear envelope, fitted deck, porch heights, iron fretwork and modern addition joints are approximate. The archival photograph documents only part of the historic exterior.
The focused museum model includes the main former convent mass and generalized linked eastern service and gallery volume. Museum exhibits and separate premises are outside scope.
next: Build the red brick Gothic gable, paired-iron veranda, steep dormered roof and rear service wing.
